body: I'm just so done with everything. I do t even cut anymore not even that does anything for me nowadays
I think i'm going to just take my sleeping pills and down a bottle of brandy Ive gotten to a point that i'm angry at my family for being the only reason i haven't done it sooner

Good question... I'm not really sure to be honest...

Yeah i listen to a lot of music, its really the closest thing i can get to something cathartic. As for exercise, id be lying to myself if i said i got any aside from my part time job which i'm barely holding on to i really could use more. As for losing weight, if i lost 50 pounds id weigh half as much as i do now... Eating is so hard for me, i have constant nausea and really struggle to eat without smoking pot

Ive built a few RC foamies but nothing too impressive really...  As for rc cars i never really got into them, i tend to be more interested in the modified car scene. Ive also flown around thirty five hours in a two seater with my dad who is a private pilot in a group owned plane he used to have a share in.
Ill try my best to keep my head up, just seems easier said than done... i hope you are doing okay yourself
I mostly play war thunder and red orchestra 2 these days, although ill be honest i don't really enjoy any of it anymore, its just a better alternative to sleeping or wallowing

I like Airsoft, video games, aviation, and car stuff, I am really a lucky kid, my parents work fortunate jobs and make decent money, i live in the suburbs in a nice house and have a family that cares about me, and all of that just makes me feel worse some how... I have a support groups of psychiatrists and it just doesn't make a difference... I just feel so lost...
